Life:Be-Born: A BE-BORN Event occurs whenever a PERSON Entity is given birth to. We do not include the birth of other things or ideas.
Life:Marry: MARRY Events are official Events, where two people are married under the legal definition.
Life:Divorce: A DIVORCE Event occurs whenever two people are officially divorced under the legal definition of divorce. We do not include separations or church annulments.
Life:Injure: An INJURE Event occurs whenever a PERSON Entity experiences physical harm. INJURE Events can be accidental, intentional or self-inflicted.
Life:Die: A DIE Event occurs whenever the life of a PERSON Entity ends. DIE Events can be accidental, intentional or self-inflicted.
Movement:Transport: A TRANSPORT Event occurs whenever an ARTIFACT (WEAPON or VEHICLE) or a PERSON is moved from one PLACE (GPE, FACILITY, LOCATION) to another.
Transaction:Transfer-Ownership: TRANSFER-OWNERSHIP Events refer to the buying, selling, loaning, borrowing, giving, or receiving of artifacts or organizations.
Transaction:Transfer-Money: TRANSFER-MONEY Events refer to the giving, receiving, borrowing, or lending money when it is not in the context of purchasing something
Business:Start-Org: A START-ORG Event occurs whenever a new ORGANIZATION is created.
Business:Merge-Org: A MERGE-ORG Event occurs whenever two or more ORGANIZATION Entities come together to form a new ORGANIZATION Entity
Business:Declare-Bankruptcy: A DECLARE-BANKRUPTCY Event will occur whenever an Entity officially requests legal protection from debt collection due to an extremely negative balance sheet.
Business: End-Org: An END-ORG Event occurs whenever an ORGANIZATION ceases to exist
Conflict:Attack: An ATTACK Event is defined as a violent physical act causing harm or damage. ATTACK Events include any such Event not covered by the INJURE or DIE subtypes
Conflict:Demonstrate: A DEMONSRATE Event occurs whenever a large number of people come together in a public area to protest or demand some sort of official action.
Contact:Meet: A MEET Event occurs whenever two or more Entities come together at a single location and interact with one another face-to-face.
Contact:Phone-Write: A PHONE-WRITE Event occurs when two or more people directly engage in discussion which does not take place ‘face-to-face’
Personnel:Start-Position: A START-POSITION Event occurs whenever a PERSON Entity begins working for (or changes offices within) an ORGANIZATION or GPE.
Personnel:End-Position: An END-POSITION Event occurs whenever a PERSON Entity stops working for (or changes offices within) an ORGANIZATION or GPE
Personnel:Nominate: A NOMINATE Event occurs whenever a PERSON is proposed for a START-POSITION Event by the appropriate PERSON, through official channels.
Personnel:Elect: An ELECT Event occurs whenever a candidate wins an election designed to determine the PERSON argument of a START-POSITION Event.
Justice:Arrest-Jail: A JAIL Event occurs whenever the movement of a PERSON is constrained by a state actor.
Justice:Release-Parole: A RELEASE Event occurs whenever a state actor (GPE, ORGANIZATION subpart, or PERSON representative) ends its custody of a PERSON Entity.
Justice:Trial-Hearing: A TRIAL Event occurs whenever a court proceeding has been initiated for the purposes of determining the guilt or innocence of a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE accused of committing a crime. A HEARING Event occurs whenever a state actor (GPE, ORGANIZATION subpart, or PERSON representative) officially gathers to discuss some criminal legal matter.
Justice:Charge-Indict: A CHARGE Event occurs whenever a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE is accused of a crime by a state actor. An INDICT Event occurs whenever a state actor takes official legal action to follow up on an accusation.
Justice:Sue: A SUE Event occurs whenever a court proceeding has been initiated for the purposes of determining the liability of a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE accused of committing a crime or neglecting a commitment.
Justice:Convict: A CONVICT Event occurs whenever a TRY Event ends with a successful prosecution of the DEFENDANT-ARG.
Justice:Sentence: A SENTENCE Event takes place whenever the punishment (particularly incarceration) for the DEFENDANT-ARG of a TRY Event is issued by a state actor
Justice:Fine: A FINE Event takes place whenever a state actor issues a financial punishment to a GPE, PERSON or ORGANIZATION Entity, typically as a result of court proceedings.
Justice:Execute: An EXECUTE Event occurs whenever the life of a PERSON is taken by a state actor.
Justice:Extradite: An EXTRADITE Event occurs whenever a PERSON is sent by a state actor from one PLACE
Justice:Acquit: An ACQUIT Event occurs whenever a trial ends but fails to produce a conviction. This will include cases where the charges are dropped by the PROSECUTOR-ARG.
Justice:Appeal: An APPEAL Event occurs whenever the decision of a court is taken to a higher court for review.
Justice:Pardon: A PARDON Event occurs whenever a head-of-state or their appointed representative lifts a sentence imposed by the judiciary.
